standard_prerequisites.use: Shows every weakly associated point of the module is a relative associated point, and that purity makes each of those the specialization of a point of the fibre, so injectivity there propagates.

core_obligations: Reduce to the kernel: it suffices to show that the kernel has no weakly associated points, and those are contained in the weakly associated points of the module (proof lines 5563-5569).

Use flatness and purity: for a flat module the weakly associated points are relative associated points, and purity makes each of them a specialization of a point of the special fibre (proof lines 5570-5576).
Conclude: injectivity of the map at those fibre points gives injectivity at every relative associated point, hence the kernel vanishes there, so the map is injective (proof lines 5577-5578).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the kernel's weakly associated points (proof lines 5563-5569).
Flatness plus purity reduce to the fibre (proof lines 5570-5576).
Injectivity on the fibre propagates (proof lines 5577-5578).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that over a local base, for a flat finite type module pure along the special fibre, injectivity of a map of quasi-coherent modules is equivalent to injectivity of its stalk map at the associated points of the special fibre (statement lines 5546-5560, tag 05MC-adjacent). The proof replaces injectivity by the vanishing of the weakly associated points of the kernel, uses that those sit inside the relative associated points of the flat module, and that purity makes each relative associated point a specialization of a fibre point where injectivity is known. The reduction through weakly associated points is the substance, so the claim is H2.
